about: The laws. Each is held by named checks (heldBy) and put at risk by changing the files in threatenedBy. docs/ENGINEERING_SYSTEM.md section 3.1. PROTOCOL-class: changing this file needs an approval record.

invariants.statement: Evidence is not interpretation: an observation says what happened and nothing of what it means for a person (no kind, owner, origin or status).

heldBy.check: an observation has no kind, owner, origin or status of Orb's own
the normalizer emits facts, never loop words: it names no kind, owner or origin

invariants.statement: Every observation has provenance: a source, an adapter and a tier, and an inferred subject names the rule that inferred it.

heldBy.check: every fact is attributed to the sender, by this adapter, at tier T0, naming the rule that read it

invariants.statement: The same fact read twice is one fact: observation identity is idempotent, and so is keeping and the ledger.

heldBy.check: the same fact has the same id, however often it is read
and reading everything twice changes nothing
the same facts again write nothing

invariants.statement: Replay equals live: the ledger and the observations rebuilt from sealed bundles are exactly those computed from the live facts.
invariants.source: CONSTITUTION Art. I; CLAUDE.md (every feature replayable); MONEY_PHONE.md §12

heldBy.check: replay == live: the ledger from the sealed bundles has the same fingerprint as the ledger from the live facts
and decode(encode(x)) is x: same ids, same facts, ordered by when they happened

invariants.statement: Raw source text never enters the journal, an export, a probe or a fit report: only counts, blinded keys and names of closed vocabularies.

heldBy.check: the journal holds no sender code, no amount, no id and no fact
the journal holds no amount, sender code or account: only blinded keys, months and counts
no word of any message, and no number of any person
the store keeps no raw text: it sees only Observations
the probe prints counts that add up and never a word of any message
the command line: summary exits 0, a broken chain exits 1, an unreadable file exits 2, and no payload value is printed

invariants.statement: Nothing closes without the person: closing is not an effect of any observation, time passing never closes a loop, and evidence that only suggests never changes a state.

heldBy.check: closing is not an effect: no CLOSE, only CLOSURE_CANDIDATE
four effects, and closing is not one of them
a year later it is still overdue: absence is never closure
evidence that suggests it is closed does not change the state
nothing in the fold moves a loop to done on its own

invariants.statement: The ledger is not a view of loops: money moved is read from value.moved alone; a movement with no loop and a loop with no movement are both possible, and they meet only in correlation.

heldBy.check: the ledger is not a view of loops: it names no loop, correlator, interpreter or commitment
it reads value.moved and nothing else
a payment with no open obligation is the ledger only [0]

invariants.statement: Quieting a source never rewrites, closes or erases what the person already accepted or what Orb already kept.

heldBy.check: every loop and commitment event is exactly as it was
a mark touches no loop or commitment: the marking code names neither
marking a source quiet does not erase it

invariants.statement: One source's kept observations can be erased without touching another's, and erasing is destroying the key.

heldBy.check: erasing one source destroys only its bundles
the others are untouched
erasing everything destroys every bundle

invariants.statement: How a subject is known decides how strongly evidence points: a rule's inference only suggests; a reference the source gave is exact; neither closes.

heldBy.check: the evidence class follows how the subject is known
the same payment with a reference the source gave is exact evidence — and still only a candidate [0]

invariants.statement: The ledger says moved, never spent or earned, and never adds one currency to another.

heldBy.check: it never says spent or earned
a line for each account and currency, in a fixed order, amounts in whole units with two places
the screen says spent and earned once each: to say it does not show them

invariants.statement: Declared confidence is metadata: nothing that decides ever reads it as a quantity or compares it with a threshold.

heldBy.check: Interpreter never reads confidencePercent as a quantity: it is declared, never compared
Correlator never reads confidencePercent as a quantity: it is declared, never compared
SmsNormalizer never reads confidencePercent as a quantity: it is declared, never compared
nothing that decides compares a confidence with a threshold

invariants.statement: Keeping facts is the person's recorded decision, made at the one place that keeps them, and switching it off erases nothing.

heldBy.check: one place keeps facts — the Keep dialog on the Sources screen
and it asks first, then records the person's yes before it keeps
and erases nothing
a revoked capability stops keeping: keepFacts is only reached from the dialog, which only the button opens

invariants.statement: A capability's words are frozen with its version: a change to what it says is a different capability.

heldBy.check: keeping facts: its words are pinned
a change to the declaration is a different capability: this text is pinned

invariants.statement: Every service message is counted in exactly one disposition, and the dispositions add up to the service total.

heldBy.check: every service message has exactly one disposition: they add up to the service total
a quiet sender's messages are not loops, and the dispositions still add up

invariants.statement: Orb has no network: the manifest asks for no INTERNET, so nothing it reads can leave the phone by its own act.

heldBy.check: the manifest asks for no INTERNET
